title: Talk to expert
intro: Registered dietitians, doctors, psychologists and fitness coaches, by video, voice or chat. Book time wey fit you.
emergency: E no be for emergency. If you need help sharp-sharp, call 112 or go the nearest hospital.
empty: No expert match wetin you choose. Try another language or day.
noSlots: No time for the next two weeks

focus.eating: How you dey relate with food

expectItems: Private {{minutes}}-minute meeting by video, voice or chat.
Time to talk about your target, your health check result and your questions.
Short written summary and next steps after, wey dem go save for your records.
profile.verifiedNote: Living Dose dey check the registration of every health worker before dem join, and we dey check am again from time to time.

book.title: Book meeting
book.noTimes: No time remain for this day. Abeg choose another one.
book.note: Anything wey dem suppose know first?
book.noteHint: E no compulsory. No put anything wey you go prefer talk face to face.
book.share: Share my last health check result with {{name}}
book.shareHint: Dem go see your Living Score and the main numbers, no be every answer wey you give.
book.payment: No payment now. We go confirm payment details with you before your meeting.
book.policy: You fit cancel or change am free until {{hours}} hours before.

errors.taken: Person just book that time. Abeg choose another one.
errors.generic: The booking no go. Abeg try again.
errors.too-soon: That time too near to book. Abeg choose later time.
errors.outside-hours: That time no dey their working hours. Abeg choose another one.
errors.day-off: Dem no dey work that day. Abeg choose another day.
errors.too-far-ahead: That one too far to book. Abeg choose earlier day.
errors.too-many-bookings: You don get 5 meetings wey dey come. Abeg attend or cancel one before you book another.
errors.invalid-time: Abeg choose one of the times wey dey show.

appt.joinOpens: You fit join 10 minutes before e start.
appt.cancelBody: Your time with {{name}} for {{time}} go free for another person.
appt.cancelLate: E remain less than {{hours}} hours, so late cancellation fee fit apply.
prepare: Find quiet, private place where network dey well.
For video, test your camera and microphone, and charge your phone.
Keep your medicine and any test result wey you do recently near you.
Write down the questions wey you wan ask.
appt.paymentNote: No payment now. We go confirm payment details with you before your meeting.
appt.help: You need help? Contact us and tell us your booking reference.
appt.calendarBody: Your Living Dose meeting. Booking reference {{id}}. Open the Living Dose app make you join.

appts.title: My appointments
appts.past: Wey don pass and wey dem cancel
appts.emptyUpcoming: You no get any appointment wey dey come.
